description:
This PHP source file implements a reminderting system for calendar activities in a CRM (likely Vtiger). It retrieves upcoming activities, checks if reminders should be sent based on timing, and dispatches email notifications using PHPMailer. It also contains utility functions for email and parent info retrieval.

Main functionalities include:

classes.name: PHPMailer
classes.description: A class used for composing and sending emails via SMTP, used in the send_mail function.

classes.name: DateTimeField
classes.description: A class representing date and time information, used to handle date formatting and comparisons.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: A class providing user-related functionalities, such as retrieving the active user.

methods.name: send_mail
methods.description: Constructs and sends an email using PHPMailer with SMTP server details and recipient list.

methods.name: MailSend
methods.description: Checks whether email was sent successfully, returns true or logs the error.

methods.name: getParentMailId
methods.description: Retrieves email address of a parent record based on module type and ID.

methods.name: getParentInfo
methods.description: Returns a string with parent module type and name for a given entity ID.
